title: Q45 |x| = 1 in one line (quick reach-test format, 18.6 s)

captions.instagram:
NDA 2026 (II) · Maths · Q45. x² − 2x cos θ + 1 = 0, then |x| = ? You get 5 seconds ⏱

No quadratic formula: D = 4cos²θ − 4 ≤ 0, so the roots are x and its conjugate. Product of roots = x·x̄ = |x|² = 1, so |x| = 1 → (c).
